findings.issue_text: get_monitor_environment_context converts schedule_type in a copied config but returns the original monitor.config, discarding the display value and producing stale/raw configuration in the occurrence context

goldens.comment: The function modifies the config variable to include display values but then returns the original monitor.config instead of the modified version.
The code fetches MonitorCheckIn objects by ID when the required data already exists in previous_checkins. This creates an unnecessary database query.

Both comments point to the same bug where the modified config is not being returned.
